what: Zoom sells video meeting software, and has built a wider communications platform around it: cloud telephone service, contact centre software, events and an AI assistant.
customers: Businesses of all sizes, schools, government bodies and individual users worldwide.
money: business subscriptions to meetings, phone and contact centre
self-service subscriptions by individuals and small businesses
moat: A product that became the default verb for video calls, with reliability and simplicity that keeps users even where a competitor is bundled for free.
risks: Growth has slowed to about 4% a year
Microsoft includes Teams with Office licences that most businesses already pay for
Individual subscriber numbers decline as offices return
opportunities: Cash of about $7.2 billion against almost no debt
Analysts see about 31% upside from current levels
Cloud telephone and contact centre products grow much faster than meetings
watch: Enterprise revenue growth and seats on Zoom Phone and Contact Center.
